title: CALCULATE with no filter arguments and no row context evaluates its expression unchanged

source.quote: If there is no row context, then no context transition happens, because there would be no row context to transform.
source.supports: without a row context there is nothing to transform, so no context transition happens

derivation: No row context and no filter arguments: the filter context stays empty. 100 + 40 + 20 + 50 + 200 + 30 + 100 = 540.
notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases.
